name: Metronidazole + Neomycin Sulphate + Polymyxin B + Nystatin
drug_class: Drugs used in Vaginal and Vulval condition
indication_description:
This combination is indicated in-
  • Vaginal trichomoniasis
  • Vaginal leucorrhoeas
  • Mixed vaginal infections (Fungal or Bacterial).
therapeutic_class_description: Drugs used in Vaginal and Vulval condition
pharmacology_description: Metronidazole, a nitroimidazole, is active against various anerobic bacteria and protozoa. Nystatin is a polyene antibiotic with antifungal activity. Neomycin is an aminoglycoside. It is bactericidal and active against some gram-positive and gram-negative organisms. Polymyxin is active against gram-negative organisms including Pseudomonas aeruginosa.
dosage_description: One suppository in the vagina at bedtime for 12 days or as directed by the physician.
contraindications_description: Contraindicated to the patients who are hypersensitive to Metronidazole, Neomycin Sulphate, Polymyxin B Sulphate and Nystatin.
side_effects_description: Skin rash, urticaria may occur rarely.
pregnancy_and_lactation_description: Caution should be practiced in pregnancy and lactation.
precautions_description: Caution should be taken in case of renal impairment.
storage_conditions_description: Store in a cool and dry place, away from light & children.
